data.one_liner: Run Python code and scripts on Android inside Flutter apps using the Chaquopy SDK.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to execute Python code on Android devices by wrapping the Chaquopy SDK. It provides functions to run scripts and return outputs or errors as maps.
use_when: You need to execute Python scripts or libraries within an Android Flutter application
You want to leverage Python packages like numpy or scipy inside your app
avoid_when: You need cross-platform support for iOS (the plugin currently only supports Android)
You need complex packages like OpenCV or Matplotlib which require special configuration not yet integrated
strengths: Enables running Python code directly on Android
Supports installing Python packages via pip configuration
Runs Python code on a separate thread with timeout support
weaknesses: Only supports Android currently (no iOS support documented)
Requires complex native Gradle and manifest configurations
Chaquopy SDK requires a paid license for unlimited use without notifications/time limits
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Chaquopy Maven repositories, applying the Chaquopy gradle plugin, modifying defaultConfig with ABI filters, updating the Android manifest with PyApplication, and adding a script.py file.
